not_covered.text: A drone strike is reported on an Zawiya electrical substation in western Libya, causing a fire and power outages.
Rapid Support Forces launch drone strikes across multiple cities in Sudan, including its capital Khartoum, Bahri, and Omdurman in Khartoum State and the River Nile cites of Ad-Damir, and Atbara.
A woman is killed and 172 other people are rescued after a ferry catches fire off the coast of Bali, Indonesia.
Three people are killed, including the perpetrator, in a stabbing at a daycare in Hopkins, Minnesota, United States.

Cook Islanders vote to elect all 24 seats of Parliament amid a cost-of-living crisis and debate regarding a past partnership agreement with China. Incumbent prime minister Mark Brown faces a challenge from Cook Islands United leader Teariki
